title: CLUE：无监督事件类型归纳与标注的对比学习框架
summary: 提出CLUE框架，用于无监督事件类型归纳、命名与标注。主要贡献包括：设计联合嵌入表示同时表达动词中心视角与语义视角；利用对比损失引导聚类进行事件类型归纳；实现事件命名与优化。实验验证了方法有效性，代码已开源。
summary_en: The CLUE framework is proposed for unsupervised event type induction, naming, and annotation. Key contributions include a novel joint embedding representation capturing both verb-centric and semantic views of events, contrastive loss guided clustering for event type induction, and event naming and refinement. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness, with code open-sourced.
